title: The Gospel That Bears Fruit
subtitle: You were not improved. You were transferred.

title: All of Him
subtitle: Every power you fear, He made.

title: Christ In You, The Hope of Glory
subtitle: The treasure is a Person, and He lives in you.

title: Complete In Him
subtitle: You cannot add to full.

title: Raised With Christ
subtitle: You were raised first. Now live like it.

title: Blessed Before You Breathed
subtitle: The staggering grace of election and spiritual blessing.

title: Brought Near by the Blood
subtitle: You were far off. You were dead. But God, who is rich in mercy, brought you near.

title: The Mystery Is Out
subtitle: The excluded are included. The strangers are now sons.

title: Walk Worthy Inside and Out
subtitle: The calling you have received has a way of walking that matches it.

title: Walk in Love, Light, and Wisdom
subtitle: Once you were darkness. Now you are light. Walk like it.

title: Stand
subtitle: The armor is a Person. Put on Christ and hold your ground.

title: Joy in Chains
subtitle: Paul wrote this letter from prison. Joy appears sixteen times. This is that kind of joy.

title: The Mind That Emptied Itself
subtitle: Jesus had every right to stay in heaven. He chose to come down. All the way down.

title: Work It Out, Walk It Out
subtitle: You do not work for your salvation. You work it out, because God is at work in you.

title: All Things Loss
subtitle: Paul called the best religious resume in the room rubbish, to gain Christ.

title: Press On: Citizens of Heaven
subtitle: You are not a citizen of earth trying to reach heaven. You are a citizen of heaven deployed on earth.

title: The Settled Heart
subtitle: Peace is a garrison God stations. Contentment is a secret He teaches.

title: The King Is Here
subtitle: Will you still follow Him when He does not fit your plan?

title: He Got Up, And Everything Changed
subtitle: The risen Christ and the death of death.

title: The Fire Fell
subtitle: Heaven did not send a letter. Heaven sent a fire.

title: Worship: Who, Why, and How
subtitle: We stop watching, and we bow.
